'''Jaim Aybara''' is a young boy from [[Emond's Field]].{{ref/book|c|Jaim Aybara}}

== Appearance ==
He has dark, curly hair.

==History==
He is a distant cousin of [[Perrin Aybara]] and his only known living relative (aside from [[Faile Bashere]]).

== Activities ==
He was sent by [[Tam al'Thor]] to tell Perrin that the men from [[Deven Ride]] have broken the southern [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}
